lines.speaker: Zenophantus
lines.text: So how did you die, Callidemides? In my case — well, you know: I was Deinias's dinner-companion, I overate, I choked. You were there when I went.

lines.speaker: Callidemides
lines.text: I was. But mine — mine was something else. You knew old Ptoeodorus, I take it?

lines.speaker: Zenophantus
lines.text: The childless one. The rich one. The one you were forever hanging around.

lines.speaker: Callidemides
lines.text: That's him. I'd been working him for years — he kept promising he'd die and leave me everything. But the business dragged on, and on, and the old man was outliving Tithonus, so I found myself a shortcut to the inheritance. I bought some poison, and I talked the wine-pourer into it: the moment Ptoeodorus called for a drink — and he likes it strong, mind you — the boy was to have the cup ready, drop the stuff in, and hand it over. And if he did it, I swore I'd manumit him.

lines.speaker: Zenophantus
lines.text: And? You look like you're about to tell me something choice.

lines.speaker: Callidemides
lines.text: So we come back from the baths, and the lad has two cups standing ready — the one with the poison for Ptoeodorus, the other one for me. And somehow — I don't know how — he muddles them. Gives me the poison. Gives Ptoeodorus the clean cup. [pause] Ptoeodorus drinks. And I — within the minute — I'm stretched out flat on the floor, a substitute corpse in his place. [pause] What are you laughing at, Zenophantus? Really. You shouldn't laugh at a friend.

lines.speaker: Zenophantus
lines.text: [laughs] Forgive me — it's just a very neat business, Callidemides. And the old man? What did he do?

lines.speaker: Callidemides
lines.text: Well, at first he was rattled — the suddenness of it. But then he worked out what had happened, and he started laughing too. At what the wine-pourer had done.

lines.speaker: Zenophantus
lines.text: All the same — you shouldn't have taken the shortcut. The main road would have got you there more safely. A little slower, perhaps. But more safely.
